summary_en: Authorized acquisition of up to 1.7 million shares (2.47% of outstanding shares) for up to 5.5 billion yen through ToSTNeT-3 and market purchases from October 29, 2026 to March 12, 2027, with all acquired shares to be cancelled on March 31, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, the Board of Directors of Yurtec Corporation authorized the acquisition and cancellation of treasury stock. The company will acquire up to 1.7 million shares of its common stock, representing 2.47% of outstanding shares (calculated on the basis of 68,712,095 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026), for up to 5.5 billion yen. The acquisition period runs from October 29, 2026 through March 12, 2027, with purchases to be executed through ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) and market purchases under discretionary trading agreements. All shares acquired under this authorization are to be cancelled effective March 31, 2027.

The company stated that this initiative is undertaken to improve capital efficiency, enhance shareholder returns, and implement measures aligned with its goal of pursuing management conscious of capital costs and stock price. The disclosure notes that depending on market conditions, some or all of the authorized acquisition may not be executed.
